Been doing this for years! Try it:

  1. Unbutton a sleeve
  2. Fold back the cuff
  3. Keep the cuff folded and use your other hand to hold the cuff together like a french cuff
  4. On the pink side of your wrist, use your index finger to direct the button upward toward the other end of the sleeve
  5. Use your thumb to guide the button insert down toward the button (use the main button insert where the button usually goes)
  6. The button is now a cuff link!

Cheers!
LPT: Sleeves too long on your dress shirt? Fold back the cuff and pull the button through the reverse side of the main button insert to create a fake french cuff.
